data.title: Invoice BB-4471 from Beispiel Bürobedarf GmbH
data.summary: Beispiel Bürobedarf GmbH invoiced €156.91 (including 19% VAT) for toner and copy paper ordered on 28 April 2026. The letter gives two different payment dates: 13 May 2026 and 20 May 2026.
data.explanation: This is a normal invoice for an order of two toner cartridges and copy paper. You need to pay €156.91 to the bank account printed on the invoice, using BB-4471 as the payment reference (Verwendungszweck). The letter is inconsistent: the text asks for payment by 13 May 2026, but the due date (Fälligkeitsdatum) is 20 May 2026. To be safe, pay by 13 May 2026, or ask the company which date applies. If you ordered this for work or a business, keep the invoice for your tax records.
